name: Axel Gateway Bridge
description: Exposes Axel SaaS's gateway-contract REST surface. Translates Axel's POST /api/chat (and matching health/reload/usage endpoints) to OpenClaw's first-party /v1/chat/completions and runtime APIs.

chatCompletionsBaseUrl.description: Internal URL the bridge calls to reach OpenClaw's /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:18789 — the loopback address of the gateway hosting this plugin. Override only for unusual local-test setups.

defaultModel.description: Routing key passed as `model` to OpenClaw's /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Must be either `openclaw` (route to the workspace's default agent) or `openclaw/<agentId>` (route to a specific named agent). The agent's actual model — anthropic/haiku, anthropic/sonnet, … — is configured in `agents.defaults.model.primary` in the workspace template; the API caller does not override it via this field.
